No Scopus or WoS record could be found: SCImago returned nothing for ISSNs 2455-1333, 2456-1983, 2455-4952 or the title, and a third-party site says not indexed, so indexing is Unverified rather than 'No'. B rather than A2 on the evidence available; it would move to A2 only if Scopus coverage is confirmed. Supplied ISSN 2456-1983 does not match records read (2455-1333 print, 2455-4953 online).

name: Statute Law Review

The Q2 SJR result is new in 2025 after Q3/Q4 in nearly every earlier year, and the 2025 CiteScore rank (638/1162) is in the third quartile, so the lower tier applies. No charge under the standard licence; the optional OA APC amount was not read from OUP (a third-party aggregator quotes about US$4,535).

name: Frontiers in Political Science

tier_basis: Meets the A1 indexing and quartile test (Scopus Q2, ESCI, JIF 2) and the journal states single-anonymized review. Pay-to-publish APC noted, but acceptance is after peer review and the journal is in DOAJ, so no D indicator applies. Subject fit to AI and law is limited. SJR Q1 figure is from a third-party aggregator.

name: Cureus
tier_basis: Clarivate put Cureus on hold in late September 2024 and removed it from the Master Journal List in the October 2025 update (reported 27 Oct 2025; 'Editorial De-listing'); it loses its JIF and may reapply in October 2027, and WoS covers only articles from Jan 2018 to Sept 2024. Quality concerns (about 125 retractions since Dec 2022 acquisition) drove it, so it cannot be A1/A2 after delisting. Scopus: SCImago has no record by ISSN 2168-8184 or title, and a third-party list says 'not listed', but the Elsevier source list was not read directly, so Unverified. APC not read (a Feb 2026 post says fees were waived to 30 June 2026).

name: BMC Medical Ethics

tier_basis: Scopus Q1 in all three SCImago categories and a 2024 JIF of 3.1 per the Springer journal page (which implies Web of Science coverage, but the edition SCIE/SSCI/ESCI was not read, hence Unverified). The journal states peer review without specifying the model; third-party sources disagree (single-blind vs open). Subject is medical ethics, not law.

SCImago snapshot (March 2025) showed coverage 2014-2024, and current Scopus status is from a third-party Sept 2026 list check.
